query: UPDATE jobs SET state=CASE WHEN $3 THEN 'failed' ELSE 'pending' END,run_at=clock_timestamp()+make_interval(secs=>$4::double precision),claim_token=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,last_error=$5,payload=CASE WHEN $3 THEN CASE WHEN kind='webhook' THEN (payload-'token') #- '{event,data}' #- '{event,truncated}' ELSE payload-'token' END ELSE payload END,finished_at=CASE WHEN $3 THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE NULL END,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=$1 AND state='running' AND claim_token=$2 AND lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp()
